resolvedFindings.resolution: Packaging requires all13 exact renderer edits by address/RVA/original/replacement; missing/weakened/moved tests cover11 geometry sites and2 guard sites.
Packaging requires the exact independent approval file/hash, explicit boolean approval, native source hash, actual canonical patch set, complete source evidence hashes and current generator hash.

Every patch display address must equal imageBase+RVA; existing PE verification binds RVA to actual fileOffset. Regression rejects moving an approved nonrequired edit while preserving display address and bytes.
Generated TEST-HELD text now names selected workload, real duration, recycle count, rider/horse physical slots, public SpawnAgent check and managed engine restore requirement.

tests.scope: Inert synthetic packages; exact renderer guards and geometry plus schema3 managed copy/workload binding, invalid options and partial managed copy cleanup.

acceptanceScope: Renderer inputs are transitively bound to the reviewed patch and lifecycle evidence; original and replacement spans must decode exactly and preserve source file offsets.
Current package code fails closed on incomplete geometry, stale approval/evidence/build, changed generator and moved patch locations before creating output.
Required Single0/contact guards, isolated provider checks and fresh output-directory protections remain active.

Packaging now additionally binds the exact native source, patched candidate and stock Watchdog implementation to the reviewed shutdown contract. This does not change any of the 13 renderer patch bytes.

Schema3 admission packaging pins exact managed original, rewritten copy, probe module and rewrite receipt hashes; the trusted managed provider hash changes only after the source match. New outputs are removed on patcher failure.

ValidateProfile requires schema3/admission, hashes the loaded managed engine and module, configures workload before mission construction, then validates isolated providers and native worker/capacity state before enabling admission.
SubModule preserves the original managed-engine hash gate for non-native demos; native probes use the exact profile validation before game creation and mission creation.
limitations: This review approves integration logic for a restricted runtime test; it does not mark the regenerated full manifest or the game test passed.
Root must regenerate/finalize static approval and isolated profile hashes after source/evidence changes; normal packaging checks must pass before deployment.
Existing renderer asynchronous scheduling remains unchanged; this review does not independently prove backend synchronization or arbitrary third-party provider behavior.
This integration review excludes correctness of the managed admission IL rewriter itself; the separate guard-patcher review and actual runtime overflow checks are still required.

Legacy schema2 package mode remains in tooling for historical fixtures; the current module requires schema3 admission. Current cavalry/ranged launches must use --admission and explicit workload/duration/cycles.
